intro.h2: Design help, cabinets and stone from one team
paragraphs: MK Stones and Cabinets handles kitchen remodeling in Wellington, FL, from the layout to the last countertop seam. Karolina works with you on the design and the stone, and her crew does the installation.

One of our clients is an architect who has designed and built seven kitchens himself. For his daughter's home he hired Karolina instead. Our team carefully removed the 10 year old granite tops, hauled away the 30 year old cabinets, installed new ones and set the original granite back in place. He called the work perfect. Other reviewers praise Karolina's quick replies to every single question.

services.h2: Our kitchen and bath services in Wellington

items.name: Kitchen design and remodeling
items.blurb: Karolina helps plan the kitchen with you and makes sure everyone in the family signs off before work starts. One client says she efficiently helped with the design and worked carefully to win his daughter's approval. The finished modern kitchens in our photos show the range.

image.alt: Modern kitchen with white lower cabinets, open wood shelving, stainless range and long countertop

items.name: Granite, quartz and stone countertops
items.blurb: Stone is in our name. We help you pick slabs that suit your needs and style, then cut and install them, including undermount sinks. A client with high expectations says the countertops in her house came out exactly to her liking.

image.alt: White and gray veined stone countertop with undermount sink cutout on gray cabinets

items.name: New kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Gray shaker cabinets, white flat-panel kitchens and full-height pantry runs. We remove and dispose of the old boxes, install the new cabinets level and square, and coordinate the countertop work so the kitchen comes together in one project.

image.alt: Gray shaker kitchen cabinets with blue-gray granite countertops and stainless dishwasher

items.name: Keep your granite, replace your cabinets
items.blurb: If your countertops are still good but the cabinets are worn out, we can lift the granite, replace the cabinets underneath and reinstall the same tops. We did exactly that for an architect's daughter: 10 year old granite saved, 30 year old cabinets gone.

image.alt: Gray shaker cabinets with the original dark granite countertop reinstalled and granite backsplash

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Our team also remodels bathrooms, often together with the kitchen. One couple redid their kitchen and bathrooms with Karolina and says her installation crew was professional, worked with precision and did a phenomenal job cleaning up when the work was finished.

image.alt: Stainless undermount sink in white veined quartz with polished nickel gooseneck faucet

items.title: Answers right away
items.text: Reviewers mention it again and again: Karolina is always available, replies immediately and gives helpful insight, even to a client who calls herself exhausting, with many questions.

items.title: Trusted by an architect
items.text: A client who has designed and built seven kitchens on his own hired us for his daughter's kitchen and called our work perfect.

items.title: Careful, respectful crew
items.text: Our installers are described as delightful, respectful of your home, precise and professional. One couple says the crew did a phenomenal job cleaning up after the job.

items.title: One team, start to finish
items.text: Design, stone selection, cabinet removal, installation and countertops are coordinated by the same team, which clients describe as end to end great service.

about.text: MK Stones and Cabinets is a kitchen remodeler with an office at 3132 Fortune Way in Wellington, Florida. Karolina Bell leads the work: she meets you, helps with design and stone selection, and coordinates the crew that installs your cabinets and countertops. Clients describe her with words like courtesy, professionalism, kindness and determination, and one called her a rare find. The company replies to reviews as the MK Stones and Cabinets Team, thanking clients and their referrals. Our reviews are all five stars, from countertop-only jobs to full kitchen and bathroom remodels.
about.owner_role: Leads design and projects (named in every review; Karolina Bell's name is published with the business phone number)

image.alt: Open white kitchen with waterfall island and stacked stone accent wall

steps.title: Meet Karolina
steps.text: Call (561) 452-3551 and talk through your kitchen or bathroom. Karolina answers questions quickly and helps you see what is possible.

steps.title: Design and approval
steps.text: We work out the design with you and the people who matter, like the client whose daughter approved every detail before work began.

steps.title: Pick your stone
steps.text: We help you choose the slabs and cabinets that suit your needs and style, so the countertops come out exactly to your liking.

steps.title: Remove and install
steps.text: The crew removes old tops and cabinets carefully, disposes of what goes, installs the new cabinets and sets the countertops with precision.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: When the work is done, our crew cleans up. Clients say they were respectful of the home from start to finish.

testimonials.h2: What clients say about Karolina and the crew

items.name: Peter W.
items.text: Karolina and her team did an excellent job! Please take note I’m an architect and on my own I’ve designed and built my kitchen, my son’s and 5 others. This time I couldn’t, so we hired Karolina. She efficiently helped us with the design, worked carefully to obtain my daughter’s approval, and coordinated her team to carefully remove the 10 year old granite top, dispose the 30 year old cabinets, install new one, then successfully reinstall the counter tops. Their work was perfect, and we are very happy to refer them to you!

items.name: Ashley W.
items.text: 10* quality, with people who take great pride in their business and quality of craftsmanship. I am an exhausting client with many questions and high expectations; Karolina was always available with immediate response times and helpful insight to make the countertops in our house exactly to our liking. Even the people who came to install the stone were absolutely delightful and respectful to our home - end to end great service. Highly recommend!

items.name: Judith D.
items.text:
My husband and I had the privilege of working with Karolina when we were redoing our kitchen and bathrooms. From the moment we met Karolina she demonstrated courtesy, and professionalism. As the project progressed Karolina remained steadfast with prompt responses and determination to exceed our expectations. She did not falter. Not once. Her unmatched level of skill and talent coupled with her kindness and thoughtfulness make Karolina a rare find. Her installation crew was also professional, worked with precision and even did a phenomenal job cleaning up after the job was done!
We highly recommend Karolina and her crew at MK Stones And Cabinets for kitchen and bathroom remodeling.

service_area.text: Our office is at 3132 Fortune Way, Suite D9, in Wellington, Florida, and Wellington is the home base for our kitchen, cabinet and countertop work. If you live outside Wellington and want to know whether we can take on your project, call (561) 452-3551 during office hours, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 4:30 PM, and Karolina will let you know.

items.q: Can you replace my cabinets but keep my granite countertops?
items.a: Yes, when the stone is in good shape. For one family we carefully removed their 10 year old granite tops, took out and disposed of the 30 year old cabinets, installed new cabinets and then reinstalled the original countertops. The client, an architect, called the work perfect.

items.q: Do you help with kitchen design?
items.a: Yes. Karolina helps with the design and with picking stones and cabinets that suit your needs and style. One client said she efficiently helped with the design and worked carefully to get his daughter's approval before the crew started on the kitchen.

Yes. We remodel kitchens and bathrooms. One couple redid their kitchen and bathrooms with Karolina and recommends MK Stones and Cabinets for both, praising the installation crew's precision and the cleanup at the end of the job. Call to talk through your bathroom.

items.q: Where is your office and when are you open?
items.a: Our office is at 3132 Fortune Way d9, Wellington, FL 33414. We are open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 4:30 PM and closed on weekends. Call (561) 452-3551 or email kbrealtorpb@gmail.com to set up a time to talk.

items.q: How quickly will I hear back?
items.a: Fast responses are one of the things clients mention most. Reviewers describe Karolina as always available with immediate response times and prompt replies throughout the project, even for a client with many questions and high expectations about her countertops. Call (561) 452-3551 on a weekday.

final_cta.text: Call Karolina to talk about cabinets, stone and design.
